experiment: Direct player-to-Sim conversation via banter.say and native in-game UiDialogTextInputOkCancel modal (banter.talk)
mechanisms_verified: banter.say <message>: sends a player_chat event from the active Sim to the currently conversing or nearest instanced Sim.

banter.talk [first last]: opens a native Sims 4 UiDialogTextInputOkCancel modal with the active Sim portrait, prompt header, and text input field; submitting OK triggers player_chat generation and displays the dual-portrait speech notification.

persistent_tts_worker_optimization.mechanism: companion.py now keeps a warm persistent PowerShell System.Speech worker across requests instead of spawning a new process per exchange.
persistent_tts_worker_optimization.speedup_vs_cold_spawn: ~10-20x faster than the previous 0.60-0.82s per-call subprocess spawn.
